captions_note: the title screen covers the whole frame, so build.py writes work/reel_captions.json and the reel's captions step aside from the cut until the phone has grown back
in_a_reel: TITLE holds words the speaker says, one line per entry, landing on the frame each is said (words.json of the slot)
T_IN 2 or later; the phone comes back 6 frames or more after the last line and grows back 8 frames or more later; the card is over 2 frames before the slot ends
the timecode and the play bar show the reel's own time and length: nothing to invent
steps: edit the CLIP block in build.py: T_IN, TITLE (frames from words.json), PHONE_AT / FULL_AT if the defaults fall badly
run build.py SAFE=1      # prints the frames and the snapshot times
